description_for_human: A platform for building and running desktop automations at scale with computer use agents.
description_for_model: Minicor automates legacy desktop software (EHRs, ERPs, DMS, WMS, PMS) that has no APIs. One API call triggers a full desktop workflow on a Windows VM. Automations are stored as deterministic code and self-heal when UIs change. SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant.
